string.text: Camera height at which borders start to become visible. Lower values make borders appear when zoomed in closer. [Default: 30]
Camera height at which borders reach full opacity. [Default: 300]
Key to cycle the display: off, borders, borders + territory tint, territory tint only. With Territory Tint disabled it only turns borders on or off. [Default: M]
Width of each kingdom's border strip in world units. [Default: 1.05]
Gap between two adjacent kingdom border strips. [Default: 0.30]
How far above the terrain surface the border is raised. Increase if borders clip into mountains. [Default: 0.55]
Renders borders over water surfaces. [Default: disabled]
Resolution of the territory grid used to calculate borders. Higher values produce more precise borders at the cost of rebuild performance. [Default: 150]
Writes detailed diagnostic information to KingdomBorders.log in the logs folder inside the mod folder. Disable to avoid unnecessary disk writes. [Default: disabled]
Number of smoothing iterations applied to border corners. Higher values produce smoother curves but increase geometry and rebuild cost. [Default: 3]
Draw only borders your kingdom shares with its neighbours. Ignored if you have no kingdom. [Default: disabled]
Low-res kingdom colour fill, visible when zoomed far out (cycle with the hotkey). [Default: enabled]
Shows each kingdom's name and fief/clan count over its territory when zoomed out. [Default: enabled]
Camera height above which kingdom labels are shown. With Debug Logging on, the hotkey message shows the current camera height. [Default: 300]
Camera height above which town nameplates are hidden, like vanilla hides village/castle plates. 0 = never. [Default: 600]
Solid, dashed or dotted strips. [Default: Solid]
Your kingdom's strips are wider and brighter; others are dimmed. [Default: disabled]
Strips between kingdoms at war pulse. [Default: enabled]
Newly gained border glows for one day. [Default: enabled]
